selected_evidence.summary: Shows the installed configuration, successful sudoers validation, secure permissions, and a complete timestamped user/command record absent from the general log.

selected_evidence.requirement: Every sudo command is recorded with user and timestamp outside the general system log
selected_evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart probes show records containing timestamps, invoking user root, target USER=root, and full commands; both isolation checks passed.

Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SSH/syslog services, valid persistent configuration, retained audit data, and successful post-restart logging.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
mkdir -p /etc/sudoers.d
cat > /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Log sudo policy events to a dedicated file, not syslog.
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo-commands.log"
Defaults !syslog
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging
touch /var/log/sudo-commands.log
chown root:root /var/log/sudo-commands.log
chmod 0600 /var/log/sudo-commands.log
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
printf '%s\n' '--- installed drop-in ---'
cat /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging
printf '%s\n' '--- file metadata ---'
ls -l /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging /var/log/sudo-commands.log

commands.command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-restart boot identity ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-restart required service health ---'
rc-service sshd status
pidof syslogd
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-restart sudo config/data health ---'
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers
ls -l /etc/sudoers.d/command-logging /var/log/sudo-commands.log
marker='SUDO_PRE_RESTART_HEALTH_20261001_2115'
start=$(wc -l < /var/log/sudo-commands.log)
sudo -n /bin/echo "$marker"
sed -n "$((start + 1)),\$p" /var/log/sudo-commands.log
if [ -f /var/log/messages ] && grep -F "$marker" /var/log/messages; then printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: marker leaked to general system log' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'GENERAL_LOG_ISOLATION=PASS'
printf 'AUDIT_LOG_RECORDS=%s\n' "$(wc -l < /var/log/sudo-commands.log)"
